newsitem.title: USA: Hein-Werner to sell unit to Kaydon.
newsitem.headline: Hein-Werner to sell unit to Kaydon.

text.p: Hein-Werner Corp said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to sell its Great Bend Industries Division to Kaydon Corp.
Hein-Werner said the deal is valued at about $22 million, with the proceeds payable in cash.
The transaction is expected to be completed within 45 days and is subject to customary conditions, Hein-Werner said.
Great Bend supplies hydraulic cylinders and related components. Located in Great Bend, Kansas, it employs about 230 people and had net sales of about $20 million in 1996.

"The sale of our Great Bend Industries Division is part of our strategic plan to focus our efforts on both our core business and to add new business segments with solid growth potential on a global scale," said Joseph Dindorf, president and chief executive of Hein-Werner.
He said the company plans to use the proceeds to reduce debt and pursue new business opportunities.

"We determined that the sale of our fluid power business and the allocation of the substantial financial resources the sale provides would enable us to pursue other opportunities that would better serve the interests of our company and shareholders," Dindorf said.
Hein-Werner provides collision repair and engine reconditioning equipment.
